name: @pipeworx/mcp-base64

tools.name: base64_encode
tools.description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 / Base64URL / Base32 / Hex (keyless, offline). Set `variant` (default base64).

variant.description: Encoding: base64 (default), base64url, base32, or hex.

tools.name: base64_decode
tools.description: Decode Base64 / Base64URL / Base32 / Hex back to UTF-8 text (keyless, offline). Set `variant` (default base64).

variant.description: Encoding: base64 (default), base64url, base32, or hex.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-base64 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the base64 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
